approved.en: Russian forces have intensified attacks on Ukrainian civilian sites, striking a humanitarian hub, a hospital, a hospice and power plants, causing dozens of deaths and many injuries. Ukrainian drones are now being used to evacuate wounded troops from the front lines, while Russia has deployed heavily-armed drones and carried out a large mass attack on Ukraine's energy grid. The ceasefire in Oleshky is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces, and a Russian Su‑57 fighter was lost to an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
